jurisdiction: Japan — national statutory amounts (自動車重量税, 自賠責保険 基準料率, 検査手数料) and the standard rates (標準税率) of the prefectural 自動車税 and municipal 軽自動車税, as published by Tokyo Metropolitan Government and Kōtō City (both levy the standard rate). 自賠責 figures are for 離島以外の地域（沖縄県を除く）.
refreshRule: Re-verified every 35 days and on the known change dates: the new 自賠責 基準料率 applies to policies whose 保険期間 starts on or after 2026-11-01 (the current-table figures end 2026-10-31; the 25- and 37-month rates of the new table are not yet published on an official page reachable today); the 自動車重量税 table runs 2026-05-01 to 2028-04-30 (エコカー減税 bands step down on 2027-05-01); 自動車税 and 軽自動車税 are assessed on 1 April each year (税制改正 announced in December); 検査手数料 changed 2026-04-01.
verificationMethod: Every figure was read on verifiedDate from the official page or PDF in its `source` (fetched with curl, browser User-Agent; every source returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-24; PDFs read with pdftotext -layout). `quote` reproduces the table row or sentence the value was taken from (whitespace normalised). The figure list follows car_websites/shaken-data/data/jp-costs/figures.json (status VERIFIED only); every value was re-read from the source today. `term` keeps the Japanese term; `label` is an English gloss.
licence: 国土交通省 (mlit.go.jp), 金融庁 (fsa.go.jp) and 総務省 (soumu.go.jp) content: "権利表記の記載がない限り「公共データ利用規約（第1.0版）」（PDL1.0）に準拠した利用条件の下で、利用することができます" (each site's 著作権 page). 自動車技術総合機構 (naltec.go.jp), 東京都主税局 (tax.metro.tokyo.lg.jp) and 江東区 (city.koto.lg.jp) pages are copyright their publishers and permit quotation (引用) under the Copyright Act; their statutory amounts are quoted briefly with attribution and no page content is reproduced beyond the cited row.

weight-tax-eco.title: エコカー減税 (自動車重量税) — new-registration reductions and the first-inspection exemption, 2026-05-01 to 2028-04-30
weight-tax-eco.scope: Passenger cars. auto-tax.title: 自動車税 (annual automobile tax, prefectural) — private passenger cars, standard rates by engine displacement
auto-tax.scope: 自家用 passenger cars (3, 5 or 7 plates), annual amount charged to the owner on 1 April (月割 in the year of registration), standard rate as levied by Tokyo; bands are by 総排気量. The column depends on the first-registration date (on/after or before 2019-10-01). Called 自動車税種別割 until 2026-03-31.

figures.label: Surcharge rule: on 1 April, petrol/LPG cars more than 13 years and diesel cars more than 11 years after first registration pay about 15% more (buses and lorries about 10%); EVs, natural-gas, methanol and petrol hybrids are excluded

figures.term: 環境性能割の廃止・種別割の名称変更
figures.label: From 2026-04-01 the 環境性能割 (acquisition levy) is abolished and 自動車税種別割 / 軽自動車税種別割 are renamed 自動車税 / 軽自動車税
figures.quote: （1）環境性能割の廃止 自動車税環境性能割及び軽自動車税環境性能割は、令和８年３月 31 日をもって廃止する。これに伴い、現行の自動車税種別割を自動車税とし、現行の軽自動車税種別割を軽自動車税とするなど、所要の措置を講ずる。

kei-tax.title: 軽自動車税 (annual light-vehicle tax, municipal) — private kei passenger cars
kei-tax.scope: 四輪以上の軽自動車 (660 cc or less), 自家用 乗用, standard rate (標準税率; 制限税率 1.5×), charged to the owner on 1 April with no 月割. The rate depends on when the vehicle first received its number (初度検査年月): before or from 2015-04-01, and 13 years after it the surcharge rate. Called 軽自動車税種別割 until 2026-03-31.

figures.label: Surcharge rule: kei cars (three or more wheels) 13 years after first given a number pay about 20% more, from the fiscal year containing the month 14 years after; electric, natural-gas, methanol, petrol-electric hybrid and towed vehicles are excluded
figures.value: 13年経過 → 概ね20%重課（14年経過した月の属する年度から）
figures.quote: 最初の車両番号の指定を受けたときから13年経過した車両については、14年経過した月の属する年度から、3.重課税率が適用となります。ただし、動力源または内燃機関の燃料が、電気・天然ガス・メタノール・混合メタノールの軽自動車およびガソリン電力併用の軽自動車ならびに被けん引車は除きます。（注釈）最初の車両番号の指定を受けた年月とは、自動車検査証の初度検査年月になります。
